dialogue.content: こんばんはよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for coming today.

dialogue.content: こんばんは！今日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening! Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: まだ少し早いですが、始めてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: It's a little early, but would it be all right if we start?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それでは始めます
dialogue.English: Alright, let's begin.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: はじめまして、今日はよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: 人前で話をすると極度に緊張するのですがどうしたらいいですか
dialogue.English: I get extremely nervous when I have to speak in front of people. What can I do about it?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 緊張すると困りことがあると思いますがいかがですか？
dialogue.English: I imagine the nervousness causes some difficulties. In what ways does it affect you?

dialogue.content: いかがとは？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by that?

dialogue.content: 当然のことを聞いてしまってごめんなさいね
dialogue.English: I’m sorry for asking something so obvious.

dialogue.content: 自分の考えを伝えようと思うのですが、いつも頭の中で考えてから口に出す癖があって疲れます
dialogue.English: I try to express my thoughts, but I have a habit of always thinking things through in my head before speaking, and it's exhausting.

dialogue.content: だから言いたいことの半分も伝えられません
dialogue.English: Because of that, I can't even get half of what I want to say across.

dialogue.content: 考えてから話すと時間がかかってしまいますものね
dialogue.English: It must take some time when you have to think before you speak.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: 言いたいことを十分伝えられないと焦ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: It must make you feel anxious when you can't fully express what you want to say.

dialogue.content: 頭であれこれ考えてしまうんです
dialogue.English: I just overthink everything in my head.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どんなことをかんがえたりしますか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of thoughts go through your mind?

dialogue.content: こう言ったらどう思われるかな？とか、間違いかな？とか変におもわれるのではとか
dialogue.English: Things like, “What will they think if I say this?”, “Is this a mistake?”, or “Will they think I’m strange?”

dialogue.content: なるほどですね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: そう考えて、無難に答えようとするので、かたい？不自然なコミュニケーションになってしまい、疲れます
dialogue.English: With those thoughts, I try to play it safe, and my communication ends up stiff and unnatural, and it’s exhausting.

dialogue.content: 人前で話すのがますます苦手意識が強くなります・・・・
dialogue.English: It makes me even more self-conscious about speaking in front of people...

dialogue.content: いろいろ心配していると、不自然になってしまうのですね
dialogue.English: So all those worries make your delivery feel unnatural.

dialogue.content: そうなのかもしれません
dialogue.English: That might be the case.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、あなたの年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, would you mind telling me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: はい、40代女性です
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m a woman in my 40s.

dialogue.content: 教えていただきありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Of course.

dialogue.content: 今はお仕事とかはされていますか？
dialogue.English: Are you currently working?

dialogue.content: しています
dialogue.English: I am.

dialogue.content: 若い時から同じ仕事です
dialogue.English: I've been doing the same job since I was young.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねずっと続けていらっしゃるんですね
dialogue.English: I see—you’ve continued in that same job for a long time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたは辛抱強い方なんだと思います
dialogue.English: It sounds like you’re a very persevering person.

dialogue.content: どちらかというとそうかもしれません
dialogue.English: I suppose that's true to some extent.

dialogue.content: なぜ、そう思われましたか？
dialogue.English: Why do you think that?

dialogue.content: 近年仕事を変える人が増えているようですので
dialogue.English: Well, it seems like more and more people are changing jobs these days,

dialogue.content: そう思いました
dialogue.English: that's why I thought that.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はい、しております
dialogue.English: Yes, I am.

dialogue.content: ところで、人前で緊張されるとおっしゃいましたが、人前で話すのはどんな場面が多いですか？プレゼンテーションとかでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, you mentioned getting nervous in front of people. In what situations do you most often speak in front of others—presentations, perhaps?

dialogue.content: 仕事柄、子ども、保護者の前などです
dialogue.English: Because of my work, it’s in front of children and their parents or guardians.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どんなお仕事をされているのですか？学校の先生とかでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What kind of work do you do? Are you a school teacher, perhaps?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね
dialogue.English: Oh, I see.

dialogue.content: それなら子供達とか、保護者の前で話す機会が多いですよね
dialogue.English: In that case, you must have many opportunities to speak in front of children and parents.

dialogue.content: 多いかどうかはわかりませんが、話す機会が度々あります
dialogue.English: I’m not sure if it’s a lot, but I do have occasions to speak fairly often.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 子供達や保護者の前で上手く伝えられないときは、どんなお気持ちになりますか？
dialogue.English: When you feel you can't communicate well in front of the children and parents, how does that make you feel?

dialogue.content: もっとわかりやすく、簡潔に話せたらよかったとか
dialogue.English: I wish I could have spoken more clearly and concisely,

dialogue.content: 自分の思いなどいれたり、ユーモラスに
dialogue.English: included more of my own thoughts, or been more humorous,

dialogue.content: など
dialogue.English: things like that.

dialogue.content: 残念な思いですかね・・・・
dialogue.English: I guess I feel disappointed...

dialogue.content: もっと上手く伝えたかったのにとか、もっと面白く話したかったのにとか思うとガッカリしてしまいますよね
dialogue.English: It must be disheartening when you think, "I wanted to communicate that better," or "I wanted to be more entertaining."

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたとしては、どうしたら人前で緊張せずに話せたらいいかということですよね
dialogue.English: So for you, the main issue is how to speak in front of people without getting nervous, is that right?

dialogue.content: でも、いつもお堅い話の仕方ばかりで、無難すぎて自分で話をしていてつまらないなと思ってしまいます。
dialogue.English: But I always end up speaking in a very formal way, and it's so safe that I find myself boring even to myself.

dialogue.content: なるほど、砕けた話とかもしてみたいという感じでしょか？
dialogue.English: I see—so you’d like to be able to speak more casually, is that right?

dialogue.content: はいそのとおりです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's exactly right.

dialogue.content: 緊張しないで、自分の意のままに反話すためにはどうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: What should I do to be able to speak freely as I intend, without getting nervous?

dialogue.content: 何かアドバイスをください
dialogue.English: Please give me some advice.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Let's see.

dialogue.content: 緊張しない方法は人によっていろいろありますが
dialogue.English: There are various methods for not getting nervous, and they differ from person to person,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 聞いている人がカボチャだと思って話すなんて言う人もいますね
dialogue.English: Some people say you should pretend the audience is a bunch of pumpkins.

dialogue.content: はい、よくききますね
dialogue.English: Yes, I've heard that one often.

dialogue.content: 他に方法ありますか？
dialogue.English: Are there any other methods?

dialogue.content: くだけた話をしたいのでしたら、自虐ネタを使うといいかもしれません
dialogue.English: If you want to speak more casually, using some self-deprecating humor might be helpful.

dialogue.content: なるほど～自虐ネタですね～
dialogue.English: I see—self-deprecating humor.

dialogue.content: あまりカッコよくやろうとせずに、笑われて元々みたいな感じですかね
dialogue.English: Instead of trying to seem too polished, it's more about adopting the mindset that it's okay if people laugh at you.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 自虐ネタいいですね
dialogue.English: Self-deprecating humor sounds good.

dialogue.content: それと、上手くやろうとせずに、たどだとしくても伝わればいいっていう感じもいいかもしれません
dialogue.English: Also, instead of trying to do it perfectly, it might be good to adopt the mindset that as long as you get your point across, it's okay even if you stumble over your words.

dialogue.content: いい恰好しようと思うから、つかれるんですね
dialogue.English: It's because I'm trying to look good that I get tired, isn't it?

dialogue.content: きっと
dialogue.English: I'm sure of it.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 次回から、もっと楽に話すことにします
dialogue.English: From now on, I'll try to be more relaxed when I speak.

dialogue.content: そうですね立て板に水みたいにすらすら話せても、聞いてる方には案外残らなかったりします
dialogue.English: That's right. Even if someone speaks very fluently, it can be surprising how little of it sticks with the listeners.

dialogue.content: そうみたいですね
dialogue.English: That seems to be the case.

dialogue.content: わかりました。少し楽になりました
dialogue.English: I understand. I feel a little more at ease now.

dialogue.content: 今日は、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: そうですね下手でもいいからって思っていると、案外聞いている人には好感を持たれるのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Right. If you think, "It's okay to be a little clumsy," you might find that the audience actually views you more favorably, don't you think?

dialogue.content: なるほどです
dialogue.English: That makes sense.

dialogue.content: お役にたてたのでしたら、嬉しいです
dialogue.English: I’m glad if I could be of help.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日は相談にきてくださり、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.content: 仕事柄、なかなか相談できるところがなかったので、今日は話ができてよかったです
dialogue.English: Because of my job, I don't really have anywhere to talk about these things, so I'm glad I could speak with you today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: No, thank you.

dialogue.content: それでは、これで本日の相談を終わらせていただきます。
dialogue.English: With that, we’ll conclude today’s session.

dialogue.content: 今日は、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。お疲れさまでした。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. Thank you for your time.
